name: Mehdi Ali

affiliations.role: Innovation group leader, foundation model research

bio: Mehdi Ali is innovation group leader for foundation model research at the Lamarr Institute and works with Fraunhofer IAIS. Ali is first author of the Teuken-7B paper, which describes multilingual models covering all 24 official EU languages, and is the founder of the PyKEEN knowledge graph embedding library.
known_for: Foundation model research at Lamarr Institute
